src/permission-types.ts.name: Approval shapes
src/permission-types.ts.description: Defines a napplet identity, what can be requested (interface, resource, network address), an approval and a decision.

src/permission-scopes.ts.name: Request clean-up
src/permission-scopes.ts.description: Checks and tidies requested paths and addresses, rejecting tricks like '..' steps, and tests whether an approval covers a request.

src/permissions.ts.name: Approval decisions
src/permissions.ts.description: Stores approvals per verified or development napplet, decides if a request is fully covered with denials winning, uses up one-time approvals, and saves them as text.
